parking_port.finding: ARM32 port exists but hardcodes four Surface RT CPU/mailbox entries at0x82001000..0x82004000 and selects only microsoft,surface-rt-efi. Not EOS support or drop-in backend.

pmio.public_source_query_results: No documented Qualcomm PMIO tuple schema verified in bounded exact QCOM2038/PMIO searches; indexed search coverage is incomplete.
pmio.finding: QCOM2038 binds Qualcomm PMIC GPIO client qcpmicgpio8960.sys, version1.0.3051.0000. This identifies a driver family, not PMIO tuple fields or exact PMIC silicon.
pmio.linux_boundary: pm8921 GPIO binding uses physical pins1..44; SSBI GPIO xlate subtracts1. Windows offsets are not Linux GPIO cells.
